packageRules.description: Immich server and ML always move together, one PR per release. Never automerge: read the release notes for breaking changes, and compare infra/docker-compose.yml with upstream docker/docker-compose.yml.
prBodyNotes:
Checklist before merge:
- [ ] Read https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases/tag/{{{newVersion}}} for breaking changes
- [ ] Diff our compose file against https://github.com/immich-app/immich/blob/{{{newVersion}}}/docker/docker-compose.yml (Postgres and Valkey digests too)
- [ ] Snapshot the DB first (Administration > Job Queues > Create Database Dump)

packageRules.description: Postgres and Valkey are pinned by Immich's own compose file. Update them only by hand, together with an Immich upgrade.
Caddy and GitHub Actions: low risk, group minor and patch updates.
